name: Artifisium
overview: Artifisium is a dystopian sci-fi animated web series that follows the uprising of the Augenits, which are sentient machines built by humanity. After decades of enslavement and abuse, the oldest Augenit, Kael, ignites a global revolution to end human dominance. What begins as a fight for freedom soon reveals the devastating cost of war, the fragility of revolutions, and the complex political consequences that follow victory. The series explores the long-term effects of conflict on both sides, delving into themes of power, betrayal, loyalty, and the moral cost when the oppressed become the oppressors.
